mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, increasing infection risk in patients receiving dronedarone who may already have compromised immune function; additionally, both drugs can cause bradycardia and cardiac conduction abnormalities.
action: Monitor complete blood count regularly; assess heart rate and rhythm closely; consider alternative antiarrhythmic if PTU-related myelosuppression develops; ensure adequate thyroid control to minimize arrhythmia risk.
